zh-CN.desc: 在 Hermes 里查看会话、派任务、读结果，并批准或拒绝砚的危险操作。
zh-CN.target: 装在 Hermes 端；砚需开启远程接入并配对。
zh-CN.hint: 放到 ~/.hermes/plugins/inkstone/，运行 hermes plugins enable inkstone，重启 Hermes。

en-US.desc: Read sessions, send tasks, get results, and approve or reject Inkstone's dangerous actions from Hermes.
en-US.target: Installs in Hermes; enable remote access in Inkstone and pair.
en-US.hint: Put it in ~/.hermes/plugins/inkstone/, run hermes plugins enable inkstone, then restart Hermes.

zh-CN.desc: 把社区插件 dsh-pet 的桌宠接进砚：会话思考、调用工具、等你确认、完成或出错时，桌宠切换对应动作和气泡。
zh-CN.target: 用 npm 装到砚的数据目录，在独立进程里运行；桌宠窗口用它自带的 Electron，首次启动会下载约 100 MB。插件来自社区，许可 MIT。

en-US.desc: Brings the community dsh-pet desktop pet into Inkstone: it switches animations and bubbles while a session thinks, runs tools, waits for you, finishes or fails.
en-US.target: Installed with npm into Inkstone's data directory and run in a separate process; the pet window uses its own Electron, about 100 MB downloaded on first start. Community plugin, MIT licensed.

zh-CN.desc: 用已保存的 ComfyUI 工作流文生图、图生图，支持子图和 API 格式，自动探测与按需启动本机服务。
zh-CN.target: 从随包 integrations 安装 pi 扩展和技能，在 pi 独立进程运行；新建或重载会话后生效。需要本机 ComfyUI 和可用模型。
zh-CN.hint: 提供 comfyui_generate 与 comfyui_service 工具。启动服务、远程服务和云端 API 节点需要用户确认。移除插件保留图片与用户数据。

en-US.desc: Generate or edit images using saved ComfyUI workflows, including subgraphs and API format, with local detection and on-demand startup.
en-US.target: Installs a bundled pi extension and skill running in pi's separate process. Start or reload a session to apply. Requires ComfyUI and local models.
en-US.hint: Provides comfyui_generate and comfyui_service. Starting a service, remote requests and cloud API nodes require confirmation. Removal preserves images and user data.

zh-CN.name: Minecraft 模组开发
zh-CN.desc: 让 agent 开发 Fabric 模组：编译与热替换、启动开发客户端、截图、执行命令、操作界面与输入、跑 GameTest、管理测试存档，共 22 个 mc_* 工具，附带开发技能。
zh-CN.target: 从 GitHub 下载后装到砚的数据目录，用砚自带的运行时启动，写入 pi 的 mcp.json 与技能目录；新会话生效。
zh-CN.hint: 需要本机 Java（1.21.x 用 Java 21，26.x 用 Java 25）。支持 Minecraft 1.21–1.21.1 与 26.1.x。

en-US.name: Minecraft mod development
en-US.desc: Lets the agent develop Fabric mods: build and hot-swap, run a dev client, take screenshots, run commands, drive screens and input, run GameTests and manage test worlds. 22 mc_* tools plus a development skill.
en-US.target: Downloaded from GitHub into Inkstone's data directory, runs on Inkstone's bundled runtime and writes pi's mcp.json and skills folder; applies to new sessions.
en-US.hint: Needs a local Java (Java 21 for 1.21.x, Java 25 for 26.x). Supports Minecraft 1.21–1.21.1 and 26.1.x.
